description: Source code for path utility functions and tests in a Git-related project, including path normalization, basename/dirname functions, and various path-related commands.

methods.name: normalize_ceiling_entry
methods.description: Normalizes an entry from GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, ensuring it is an absolute, normalized path.

methods.name: normalize_argv_string
methods.description: Normalizes command-line argument strings, handling special cases like '<null>' and '<empty>'.

methods.name: posix_basename
methods.description: Wrapper for basename() with const parameter compatibility.

methods.name: posix_dirname
methods.description: Wrapper for dirname() with const parameter compatibility.

methods.name: test_function
methods.description: Tests basename or dirname functions against predefined datasets.

methods.name: check_dotfile
methods.description: Checks if given paths are dotfiles of specific types (git modules, ignore, attributes, mailmap).

methods.name: cmp_by_st_size
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting string list items by size.

methods.name: protect_ntfs_hfs_benchmark
methods.description: Runs a benchmark for NTFS/HFS path verification performance.

methods.name: cmd__path_utils
methods.description: Main command handler for various path utility functions and tests, invoked with command-line arguments.
